Job Title: Senior Process Improvement Analyst (SYNTHETIC SAMPLE)
Company: Example Widgets Ltd (fictional)

Responsibilities
- Lead Lean Six Sigma projects to reduce waste in manufacturing processes.
- Build dashboards in Power BI and present findings to senior stakeholders.
- Map current-state processes and design improved future-state workflows.

Required skills
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt (LSS)
- Process mapping
- SQL
- Stakeholder management

Nice to have

- Power BI
- Project management (PMP or PRINCE2)
